confirmedNewAppCauses.cause: Two tokens in the imperative dictionary were treated as independent proof of a verb list, overriding fixed valid wire for productive bare-verb complements.

confirmedNewAppCauses.status: candidate fix locally reproduced; full regression/live generalization pending

confirmedNewAppCauses.cause: Verb-list inference also rejects noun-complement imperatives because the same surface word has several POS roles.
confirmedNewAppCauses.fix: Remove the unsound POS inference rather than keep extending command-head exceptions. Retain independently evidenced guards and model abstention.
confirmedNewAppCauses.risk: A model can still wrongly approve an unconnected word sequence. The app does not certify general English; this family is mandatory actual evaluation coverage and release stays held.
confirmedNewAppCauses.status: candidate local contract verified; model quality unmeasured

confirmedNewAppCauses.status: bidirectional negative and valid-correction controls pass; actual model quality unmeasured
